0x18457eb: [?f5][S57][?84] I'm gonna catch you, little sister! Heh heh heh!
0x1845854: [S5e][S58][?84] What was Team Galactic really after? Why did they steal everyone's Pokémon?
0x1845895: [?9f][S58][?84] An Escape Rope is really handy!\pUse it when you've been battered badly in Eterna Forest, and you'll be back at the entrance in a flash!
0x18458e7: [?f1][S58][?84] Once you earn a Gym Badge, you can use the matching HM.\pBut I don't have even one Gym Badge! And it's all because Gardenia is too tough!\pAaah! I can't stand Grass-type Pokémon!\pIf only I had a Flying-type Pokémon, I wouldn't have lost so badly!
0x18462b5: [S62][?84] Oh, you're a Pokémon Trainer!\pThe more Pokémon you have, the more you have to think about. And that's truly a joy!
0x1846314: [?1e63][?84] ...My big sister and little brother are just too dazzling, while I'm good for nothing. All I can do is hide by myself in this corner.
0x1846367: [S71][S63][?84] Hearthome City is a town that's really kind to kids...\pAh, no no no. I mean it's kind to kids, to grown-ups, and to Pokémon alike.
0x18463bd: [S63][?84] The kids are all clamoring for a Pokémon to call their own.\pIt'll be tough from here on, but it'll sure get lively, too.
0x1846413: [?84] You want to be treated kindly, so you treat others kindly in turn... That's really not a bad way to be.
0x1846454: [S5e][S64][?84] The Contest is a big event the whole world is watching!\pWhat do I do...! The whole world will be looking at me!
0x184649d: [S64][?84] Hearthome City draws crowds of tourists with its Super Contests and Amity Square.\pIf we don't keep it spick-and-span, that'd be a disgrace!
0x18464f8: [?84] Today I took my little Shroomish for a stroll in Amity Square!\pI fed it loads of Berries in the flavors it loves, too. So much fun!!
0x184654f: [S6a][S2b][S72][S42][S65][?84][?89][S65][?84][?80][?80][S21][S20][S27][S72][S42][S6c][?f0][S65][?84] You're a Pokémon Trainer, right? Traveling through the Sinnoh region with your Pokémon.\pBattling wild Pokémon all the time must be rough. Here, let your Pokémon hold this.
0x1846761: [S6b][S67][?84] There are Pokémon Fan Clubs all over the country, but this one's the best of them all!\pWhy, you ask? Because the speeches here are the longest. The very longest!\pSo long that everyone's started to dread coming to hear me talk...
0x1846897: [S68][?84] That Team Galactic building got remodeled after they left.\pThey rounded off all those pointless jagged corners. Really on trend!\pStill, I hear Team Galactic left a good deal of resources behind.
0x184690e: [?84] They say the Sinnoh region is split in two by Mt. Coronet.\pSome people claim they've seen a Pokémon called Shellos. No telling if it's true.
0x1846969: [S73][S69][?84] Pokémon will appear in different forms before the people they long to see.
0x184699f: [S69][?84] There are plenty of magicians in the world, but most just do tricks.\pProbably only about five percent of them are true psychics.
0x18469fa: [?84] Sure, magic tricks are all just deception, but real magic truly exists!!\pYou ask why I'm so certain? Because I saw it with my own eyes, of course! Even though the man himself flatly denied it...\pI once met a green-haired young man who warped space with the greatest of ease.\pHe said it was merely a low-level Void-type guiding-force magic called Dark Matter.\pHe brushed it off, insisting guiding-force magic is technology, not magic.\pOh please! It's got the word "magic" right in its name, so of course it's magic!!
0x1846b1a: [S24][S6b][?84] The sign originally read[?f0] "Veil Game Corner—Go for the Jackpot!!"\pBut it's been scratched out heavily, and four big words carved over it: "No Gambling."
0x1846b81: [?8b][S6b][?84] The sign originally read[?f0] "Prize Exchange Counter"\pBut it's been scratched out heavily, and four big words carved over it: "No Gambling."
0x1846bd9: [S6b][?84] If you climb Mt. Coronet, you can probably take in the whole Sinnoh region!
0x1846c0f: [?84] Mt. Coronet, towering at the center of Sinnoh...\pWhen I went to see it, it felt like the spot closest to the sky. Closest to outer space, even!
0x1846c64: [S69][S2b][S74][S42][S6c][?84][S6c][?84][?80][?80][S21][S20][S27][S74][S42][S5a][S6d][?84][?84] Put on a pair of glasses, and the world changes.\pTake the glasses off, and the world changes again.\pThat's just how it is. So, how about it? Care to try changing your Pokémon's world?
0x1846da7: [S6d][?84] I... want to grow up to be a sailor as fine as my dad!\pA sailor who fears no sea is a man among men!\pAh, but a Gym Leader would be great too! Mr. Wallace is so cool!
0x1846e22: [S2c][S6e][?84] The little rascal at my place is such a handful!\pHah! But being full of energy is the best thing there is!
0x1846e5d: [S67][S6e][?84] On the other side of the boundless sea...\pIn that far-off place, there must be Pokémon and Trainers living too.\pWhat? That's where you're from?! The Hoenn region? I'd love to see it too someday!
0x1846ed7: [S6e][?84] Pokémon have a mysterious special power known as Abilities.\pSkill Swap is a move that trades the Abilities of the opposing Pokémon and your own in battle.\pUsing this move effectively is a tough test of a Trainer's skill.
0x1846f70: [S7a][S6f][?84] You're the new Champion of the Hoenn region?!!\pMoo-hoho.........\p.......................... ..................................\pI still like Steven better!\pIn the end, I'm number one. Strong and awesome!
0x1846fe1: [S6f][?84] I really love the tea my girlfriend brews. On a snowy day like this, it warms me from head to toe.
0x1847020: [S2a][S70][?84] Come to think of it, there used to be a little kid named Akahi.\pDidn't get along with anyone. Always played alone...\pStudied really hard, though. I wonder how they're doing these days?
0x184708e: [?98][S70][?84] That Team Galactic lot seems to be stirring up trouble again lately.\pBut how come you never catch even a glimpse of Team Galactic in Sunyshore City?\pProbably because Gym Leader Volkner is, in a way, downright invincible.
0x184711a: [S24][S71][?84] That glittering, dazzling thing you're holding...\pCould it be the legendary PokeNav from the Devon Corporation?! And the newest model, too!\pHow wonderful! The PokeNav! You can call your friends anytime, anywhere, and check Pokémon data with it, too.
0x18471bd: [S71][?84] Me? I love wandering around planting Berries as I go.\pGrowing Berries is a fine thing for Pokémon, too.\pAfter all, it means more food to go around for them.
0x1847232: [S72][?84] My big sister gathers Berries every single day, so all the Pokémon at home eat their fill and are perfectly content!
0x1847276: [?80][S72][?84] My big brother often sends me over to Wayward Town. You can earn Heart Scales doing part-time work there!
0x184ad08: [?84] A mural from a far-off region. A colossal beast and a giant sea creature clash with each other, while countless meteors rain down from the cosmos far beyond the sky.
0x184aeee: [F8AE][?84] In the primeval age thousands of years ago, the land overflowed with natural energy.\pGroudon and Kyogre, having undergone Primal Reversion, waged fierce battle again and again to claim that energy.\pBefore Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre, people were powerless. They could only wait for the two Pokémon's struggle to come to an end.
0x184b7e7: [?f1][?84] If a Pokémon has no HP left, it can't keep battling.\pTo keep that from happening, stock up on plenty of medicine!
0x184b838: [S42][?84] I really want a Vitality Shard!\pBut I've only got 2 Gym Badges so far, so I can't buy one just yet...
0x184b887: [?91][?84] Have you heard of Amity Square? It's a truly lovely spot!\pStrolling through it together with your Pokémon can deepen the bond and love you share!
0x184b8f8: [?84] The Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch a species you've caught before? That's the Repeat Ball!
0x184b940: [S4a][?84] Let's bring Vitality Shards to the folks training on Iron Island as a little pick-me-up.\pThere's no Pokémon Center over there, so it must be really tough.
0x184b994: [?9e][?84] Just use a TM, and your Pokémon can learn all sorts of moves!\pBy the way, the Pokémon League's Elite Four are far tougher than any Gym Leader!
0x184b9f3: [BUFB9][?84] Even if it gets frozen solid, it'll thaw on its own after a few turns. Though an Ice Heal would be even better!
0x184ba3a: [S44][?84] Before you reach the Pokémon League, you must cross the long Victory Road.\pI hear it's a grueling path, so stock up on plenty of items...
0x184ba91: [?9b][?84] Buy some stickers at the shop and stick them on your Trainer Card!\pWhy?! Because stickers look great, and your Pokémon will be glad too!\pLet me see your Trainer Card. Whoa, so cool!!\pA pass from the Battle Frontier?! Well, looks like you really don't need any stickers.
0x184bb3a: [S44][?84] The Pokémon called Croagunk is this town's mascot!\pCroagunk's adorable, don't you think?! I really hope the whole world grows to love it!
0x184bb9e: [?84] Add a Capsule to a Poké Ball, then decorate it with Seals............\pAnd there you have it—a one-of-a-kind Ball all my own!\pHehe, do you want to try Ball Capsules too?
0x184bc7a: [?84][?84] Pokémon are mysterious, ancient creatures.\pBut a Trainer exists for one reason: to have Pokémon battle! That's all there is to it!
0x184bccf: [?84] Ah, hello there! Trainer[F9D3]\pIf you're ever unsure what to do...\pjust talk to plenty of people! Head off to all sorts of places!\pThat way, the road ahead will stretch on without end!
0x184bd52: [?84] Did you know?\pAs Pokémon keep battling, they grow stronger, and once they reach a certain point, they evolve! Some even change their form!
0x184bda8: [?84] Evolution is an expression of a Pokémon's wondrous power!\pThe secret of evolution... I wonder if the dashing Prof. Rowan can unravel it.
0x184bf51: [?84] Hahaha! Nice Pokétch, isn't it?\pMine's the newest model, with a revamped design!\pMost Trainers in Sinnoh wear a Pokétch.\pThough next to Devon's PokeNav, it does seem to come up a little short...
0x184bfe3: [?84] Have you ever bought a Heal Ball at the Poké Mart?\pIt restores the HP of the Pokémon you catch to full.\pThat way, you can send it into battle the moment you catch it!\p...That said, if you're already carrying six Pokémon, it won't do you much good.
0x184c079: [?83][?84] I love watching Pokémon use their moves!\pAs a Pokémon grows stronger, it learns more and more new moves!\pAnd that makes battling with moves ever so much more fun!
0x184c0ec: [?f6][?84] If everyone in the world had a Pokémon, we could all just sit down and talk freely.
0x184c129: [S33][?84] This Shiny Pikachu of mine was a gift from a friend!\pIt grows fast. It'll level up in no time!\pSince I've only got one Gym Badge, it sometimes ignores my orders.\pBut that's just the Badge's fault. It's not that our friendship is lacking!\pSo it's still my most precious partner!
0x184c1ee: [F8C1][?84] I came here to check on how the Pokémon I traded to my friend is growing!
0x184c22a: [Lv][?84] Every time I look at a Pokémon I got through a trade with a friend, it reminds me of my buddies!
0x184c266: [S70][?84] With 5G, you can trade Pokémon with people all over the world...\pJust hearing about it gets me excited!\pThe power of science is truly incredible!
0x184c2bc: [?84] Is the world linked by 5G vast, or is it small? I can't even begin to imagine.
0x184c2f7: [?84] Pokémon will use their held items all on their own!\pBut items like Potions and Antidotes, which a Trainer has to use, are something they don't seem to know how to handle.
0x184c35b: [S65][?84] I fully understand what it means to be a Pokémon Trainer now!\pA Trainer can carry up to six Pokémon at a time!\pSomeone who raises the Pokémon they catch and sends them into battle\pis called a Pokémon Trainer!\pA Trainer's goal is to defeat the powerful Trainers and Leaders at the Pokémon Gyms all across the land!
0x184c429: [S33][?84] Today I learned about Pokémon types!\pUhh.................\pWater beats Fire!\pFire beats Metal! Metal beats Wood! Wood beats Earth! Earth beats Water!\pAh, no no! I got it mixed up! Let me start over!\pThe Fire type beats the Grass type!\pThe Water type beats the Fire type!\pThe Grass type beats the Water type!
0x184c4c8: [?84] Whether Trainer or Pokémon, it's best to grow little by little.\pIf you force a Pokémon to grow faster through some improper outside method,\pit just might do irreversible harm to both the Pokémon and the Trainer.
0x184c565: [S6f][?84] Using a Potion restores a Pokémon's HP!\pIt's not just about ordering your Pokémon to use moves. Using items wisely is something a fine Trainer must master, too!\pOf course, in official battles you're not allowed to use extra items! Otherwise the match would never end.
0x184c611: [?84] New apps for the Pokétch are being made all the time!\pThat's right. The Pokétch is a product that evolves, just like a Pokémon!
